headline: Heavy Clashes Persist as Marban Hollow and Weathered Expanse Churn
war_summary: Base exchanges in Marban Hollow and Weathered Expanse took center stage over the past three hours, maintaining steady turnover while bloodletting across Nevish Line and Kuura Strand began to cool from earlier peaks. Nevish Line nonetheless recorded over twenty-one hundred casualties in the two-hour window alongside four fresh base flips around Tomb Father and Princefal, while Kuura Strand logged four base transfers amidst sharply declining casualty rates. Marban Hollow remained volatile with six base transitions in two hours centered on Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. In Weathered Expanse, relentless back-and-forth fighting yielded five base exchanges in two hours, driving combined daily losses in the sector past seventeen thousand. Meanwhile, Linn of Mercy witnessed heavy attritional engagements exceeding eighteen hundred casualties in two hours despite static strongpoints. Peripheral sectors including Stonecradle and Pari Peak saw frontline activity taper off after earlier skirmishes, while southern interior reaches remained thoroughly tranquil.
